collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: Two partners realize that one of them has been doing most of the household chores without either of them noticing.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two partners realize that one of them has been doing most of the household chores without either of them noticing.

choices.label: Make a List of Chores Together.
Use Pebbles to Track Who Did What.
Ask a Trusted Friend for Ideas.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They divide the work fairly, and both feel lighter.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The list is too long, so they decide some chores can simply wait.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The pebbles make the imbalance clear, and they adjust.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They forget to move the pebbles, and the system becomes a running joke.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Each learns how hard the other's chores are.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The friend shares a system from their own home, which works well.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The friend's system does not suit them, but they enjoy the conversation.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: Both discover they prefer their old chores and trade back gratefully.

c2__text.text: Both discover they prefer their old chores and trade back gratefully.
